conditions.label: ENTAILMENT

quote_checks.quote: Before its encounter, NASA had defined a minimum successful orbit period change of Dimorphos as change of 73 seconds or more.
quote_checks.label: ENTAILMENT
quote_checks.reason: This establishes the relevant pre-impact success threshold.

quote_checks.quote: Now, the investigation team has confirmed the spacecraft’s impact altered Dimorphos’ orbit around Didymos by 32 minutes, shortening the 11 hour and 55-minute orbit to 11 hours and 23 minutes. This measurement has a margin of uncertainty of approximately plus or minus 2 minutes.
quote_checks.label: ENTAILMENT
quote_checks.reason: A 32-minute change, even allowing ±2 minutes uncertainty, remains well above 73 seconds.

quote_checks.quote: Over the following weeks, the asteroid’s orbital period continued to shorten as Dimorphos lost more rocky material to space, finally settling at 11 hours, 22 minutes, and 3 seconds per orbit – 33 minutes and 15 seconds less time than before impact.
quote_checks.label: ENTAILMENT
quote_checks.reason: This later measurement independently confirms an even larger change than the 73-second threshold.

conditions.reason: NASA’s threshold was 73 seconds or more, while the cited measurements show a shortening of 32 minutes initially and 33 minutes 15 seconds after settling, both far exceeding that threshold.
